summary: Frontend-only UI verification of MAZIGHO (Node/Express/tRPC on http://localhost:3100) admin extensions: Personnalisation Style (custom colors + button radius), Contenu (home-layout studio) and Fournisseurs (Odoo graceful check), plus homepage reflection. All three feature areas render with the required data-testids and their save flows succeed with success toasts. Persistence and homepage reflection verified. Design defaults restored at the end.

ui_bugs.component: Auth session cookie (server-side, but observable only in the browser)
ui_bugs.issue: Set-Cookie for app_session_id uses 'SameSite=None; HttpOnly' WITHOUT the 'Secure' attribute. Chromium (and other modern browsers) reject SameSite=None cookies over plain http://localhost, so the session cookie is silently dropped. Result: after a successful POST /api/trpc/auth.login (200), the browser has no cookie, auth.me + admin.* return 401, and every admin page renders 'Veuillez vous connecter pour continuer' even though credentials are valid. Reproduced consistently in fresh Playwright/Chromium contexts (context.cookies() returns []). curl works because it doesn't enforce the SameSite=None+Secure rule. Fix: set SameSite=Lax (default) in dev, or set Secure only when serving over HTTPS in production.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix auth cookie flag. In the tRPC/Express session middleware that emits `app_session_id`, change `SameSite=None` to `SameSite=Lax` in dev (or only set `Secure` + `SameSite=None` when running under HTTPS in production). Without this, no browser can maintain an admin session on http(s)://localhost or any http host — the entire admin panel is unusable from a browser even though the backend is correct. Suggested code location: the Express response setCookie for app_session_id (search server code for 'app_session_id' and 'SameSite').
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie attributes for session token do not respect the browser rule that SameSite=None requires Secure. On plain http (dev/preview) this results in a silent auth failure that is very hard to diagnose (login POST returns 200, but no subsequent request is authenticated). Suggest deriving cookie flags from NODE_ENV / request.protocol.

The admin.design.update endpoint requires the full DesignProfile schema (rejects partial updates); every field including paletteId/typographyId must be sent. Consider making it a partial/merge update or clearly documenting the requirement to reduce clients accidentally wiping fields.

tRPC batching returns an unusual HTTP 207 (Multi-Status) when a single procedure inside a batch is unauthorized (auth.me OK, admin.getStats 401 in same batch). Clients then retry the batch and get 401. UX-wise the admin shell should treat 'auth.me OK + admin.* 401' as 'not admin' rather than 'not logged in'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the 3 requested feature areas (with the session-cookie workaround); 0% for real end-user login until the SameSite/Secure bug is fixed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL is http://localhost:3100 (Node app, NOT the FastAPI template). Login is at /login (French UI). Real DB. Admin routes: /admin/personnalisation, /admin/contenu, /admin/fournisseurs. Cookie name is app_session_id (JWT). CURRENT BLOCKER for pure-UI testing: server sets `SameSite=None; HttpOnly` without `Secure`, so Chromium drops the cookie on http and every admin page shows the login placeholder. Workaround used here: log in via curl to obtain the JWT, then inject it into Playwright with sameSite='Lax'. Once the server fix is applied, a fresh Playwright session should be able to complete the flow purely via the UI. Data-testids used: toggle-custom-colors, color-customPrimary/Accent/Soft, radius-flat/rounded/full, home-layout-studio, layout-block-<key>, move-up-<key>, move-down-<key>, toggle-block-<key>, add-text-banner, save-layout, odoo-status-card, odoo-status-badge, verify-odoo-btn.
rca of the issue: Login POST /api/trpc/auth.login succeeds (HTTP 200) and returns Set-Cookie: `app_session_id=<JWT>; Max-Age=2592000; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=None`. Because the response is served over plain http and the cookie has SameSite=None but no Secure flag, Chromium enforces the modern rule (SameSite=None requires Secure) and silently discards the cookie. Subsequent tRPC requests (auth.me, admin.*) have no session, so admin.getStats and admin.accounting.getOverview return 401, which causes the AdminLayout guard to render 'Veuillez vous connecter pour continuer'. Reproduction: incognito browser → /login → submit valid credentials → observe DevTools Application → Cookies: empty. Mitigation: on the server, when NODE_ENV !== 'production' (or when req.secure===false) emit the cookie with `SameSite=Lax` (or omit Secure). In production over HTTPS, keep `SameSite=None; Secure` if cross-site embedding is needed, otherwise prefer `SameSite=Lax; Secure`.
